mainEntity.name: What vegan and gluten-free options does Aura Café offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer house oat milk, almond milk, soy milk, Avocado Sourdough Tartines, Gluten-Free Acai Power Bowls, Vegan Scones, and Gluten-Free Belgian Fudge Brownies.

mainEntity.name: Can I work or study with high-speed WiFi at the cafe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Aura provides 500Mbps optical fiber WiFi and individual power outlets at all dedicated study and work benches.

mainEntity.name: How do I order takeaway or book a table?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can customize any food or drink item on our live interactive menu and submit your takeaway order or table reservation directly to our barista team via WhatsApp.
